title: People We Meet on Vacation
author: Emily Henry
summary: For ten years, two opposite best friends, Poppy and Alex, have taken one trip together every summer, until a falling out ended it. Now Poppy asks for one more week to put things right.
readIf: you love friends-to-lovers stories with travel, banter and lots of longing.
skipIf: you get impatient with characters who avoid saying the obvious for most of a book.

pairings.reason: Another warm, funny romance with a slowly deepening bond between two very different people.
A quieter, sadder story of two people who keep circling each other over years.
Another Emily Henry novel, more focused on work and family.
